name: 77705 · Beaumont, TX
findings: ZIP 77705 (Beaumont) has 73 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77705 (Beaumont) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77705 (Beaumont) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).
